## What is still open

- **#1412 needs one change before merge**: Elad approved but requires a per-batch audit event (id range, count, from/to KEK) instead of only the final summary, for PCI 10.2 traceability [3]. Your current job emits a single `KekRotationCompleted` record [1] — that's the work to do now, and Avi wants the merge done by Monday so the prod run can happen Tuesday night [3].
- **Shira needs two artifacts for the PCI on-site by Wed 25/11**: the audit-log export from the prod run and the signed change ticket (screenshots won't satisfy the assessor, Ardent/Victor) [5]. Note the per-batch audit events Elad asked for feed directly into that export.
- **Prod window is locked**: Tue 24/11, 22:00–23:30 IL time, Elad on call with you; the only fallback is Thu 26/11, because the PCI change freeze starts Tue 1/12 [6].
- The terraform decrypt-only key policy (30 days for `vault-kek-2025`/`vault-kek-2022`) is deliberately separate from #1412 [1] — it still needs its own quillon/terraform PR.

## What changed

- CI on #1412 is red only on `cargo deny` (ring 0.17.8 advisory, fixed by the still-unreviewed Dependabot PR #1405); build, test and clippy are green [1].

## What you did

- You built and hardened the KEK rotation job for card tokens: batched re-wrap to `vault-kek-2026`, explicit v1 → `vault-kek-2022` mapping (staging dry run: 1,204,880 tokens, 0 failures after the fix), decrypt-only post-rotation policy documented (no key deletion — that's Shira's call), a final audit event, and 6 new tests (212 passing) [1].
- You wrote the runbook `docs/runbooks/vault-kek-rotation.md` covering pre-checks, prod dry run, the real run, verification and the no-rollback failure path (fix and resume with `--from-id`) [2], and opened #1412 with Elad and Avi as reviewers [1].
